abstract: Choriocarcinoma is an aggressive neoplasm arising in the body of the uterus. Rapid growth and myometrial invasion may be followed by uterine perforation. In this study, we present the cases of two young patients (18 and 19 years of age) with acute abdominal pain and shock, while they were under chemotherapy due to persistent trophoblastic disease. During emergent exploratory laparotomy, localized resection of uterus was performed. They had their first successful term pregnancy 5 and 4 years after surgery, respectively. Uterine perforation following choriocarcinoma is a rare event. Hysterectomy is recommended in emergency conditions, but localized resection of uterus should be considered in women who are desirous of future fertility.
abstract_ja: 絨毛癌は子宮体部に発生する侵襲性の腫瘍である。急速な増殖と筋層浸潤に続いて子宮穿孔を来すことがある。本研究では、持続性絨毛性疾患に対する化学療法中に急性腹痛とショックを呈した、18歳と19歳の若年患者2例を報告する。緊急開腹術中に子宮の局所切除を施行した。両者は術後5年および4年で、それぞれ初回の正期産による妊娠に成功した。絨毛癌後の子宮穿孔はまれな事象である。子宮摘出術は緊急時に推奨されるが、将来の妊孕性を望む女性では子宮の局所切除を考慮すべきである。
